  - the flooded vaults of Gemin
  - the deepest hall of Vorannuhl
- **My rank:** I reported to Never-Writes-Twice in Helstrom. She made me a Reel-Ka and gave me the order's cuirass and helm plus 300 gold. I also got a free bed in every Archwarden fort.

I haven't collected any of the three stones yet. The Fort Chalkmoth cellar is also still unresolved.
